Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing weakness and fatigue; to help me determine the cause, how long have these symptoms been present and do you have any specific triggers like exercise or stress?

speaker: Patient
text: 33-year-old woman. The patient reports feeling extremely fatigued and weak, especially towards the end of the day, to the point of difficulty in self-care. She mentions experiencing these symptoms currently. The patient has been traveling, hiking, and camping recently and notes having had multiple illnesses in the recent past.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Weakness and fatigue. I also have Mild diplopia. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Urinary tract infection and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis. While your previous provider suggested a Urinary Tract Infection, your primary symptoms of weakness and fatigue combined with mild diplopia (double vision) are classic for Myasthenia Gravis, which requires specific testing to confirm. I need to rule out other causes like thyroid issues or neurological conditions immediately. REQUEST TEST: Thyroid_Stimulating_Hormone. REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine_Receptor_Antibodies. REQUEST IMAGES: Neuromuscular_Junction_Imaging.
